_about: The inventory inventory.py reads (INVENTORY_FILE). Copy it to a file of your own, keep that file private (it names your estate), and replace every <...>. Keys starting with _ are notes; any other key not shown here is refused. A record path that is not absolute is read from this file's folder.

tenants.tenant: <the first tenant's id, or one of its domain names>

owners.tenant: <the tenant's identity administrator, as a role or a mailbox>
owners.provider: <the provider's owner of this tenant, as a role or a mailbox>

watch.record: <path of the watch.json this tenant's watch schedule writes>

leavers.record: <path of the leavers.json this tenant's leaver report writes>

organizations.name: <an organization whose federation is switched off on purpose>

tenants._about: A tenant that withholds the read-only app: its watch runs declared --provider-only, and it has no leaver report to schedule, because the report needs the app.
